items.statement: Equip Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its canonical product measurable structure. Let μ=Exp(1) be the unit-rate exponential Borel measure on ℝ, define the actual countable product P=⊗_(k∈ℕ)μ, and define X_k(ω)=ω_k and ε_k(ω)=max{X_k(ω),0}, with ε_k regarded as a nonnegative real. There are no public mathematical premises. Then: (1) P is a probability measure; (2) for every k∈ℕ, X_k and ε_k are measurable and the real-coordinate pushforward (X_k)_#P equals μ exactly; (3) the entire real coordinate family (X_k) is mutually independent under P; (4) for P-almost every ω, simultaneously for every k, X_k(ω)>0 and the real coercion of ε_k(ω) equals X_k(ω); (5) for P-almost every ω, ∑_(k=0)^(n−1)ε_k(ω)→+∞ in ℝ as n→∞. The two almost-sure clauses may be intersected when used together. The sum at n=0 is zero. The carrier contains negative and zero coordinates, so positivity and clamp agreement are not universal pathwise claims. Source E_(k+1) is represented by X_k, and the actual waiting-time API may use ε_k on the simultaneous full-measure event. Explicit marginal and independence conjuncts concern X, not separately exported ε laws. This supplies the stochastic numerator background for AppendixA.1 Ex9; it does not assert an actual event-time comparison, nonaccumulation, global process, Markov property, invariant law, sampler error or expected query cost.
assumptions: Fixed carrier Ω=ℕ→ℝ, with the canonical product measurable space; ℝ and ℝ≥0 carry their canonical Borel measurable spaces. No dimension, potential, rate-cap, initialization, probability certificate, iid witness, integrability or convergence hypothesis is supplied.

The common rate is exactly1. The product, raw coordinate evaluations and total nonnegative clamp are literal definitions, with probability, measurable laws, independence and AE support proved internally.

Source E_(k+1) corresponds to X_k; range n contains exactly the first n clocks. Clamp/raw equality and positivity hold simultaneously for every k on a full-measure event, and may fail on exceptional samples.

The implementation proves divergence by the separately identified ASTIS bounded-indicator SLLN route: B_k=1_{X_k>1}, E[B_k]=exp(−1)>0 and B_k≤ε_k. The author direct Exp integrability/mean-one strong-law route is retained as an OPEN alternative source-background expansion.
